title: Recover a required check that never reported
trigger: An armed BLOCKED PR has no queue entry or pending/red required check past two refresh intervals from autoMergeRequest.enabledAt.
need: The landing becomes STALLED and its holder receives the existing per-head stopped notice. Names are best-effort from rulesets and classic protection; unknown names do not hide the alarm. Merge-when-ready stays armed. When the head commit has a workflow run queued or in progress for under two hours, the advice names the run, says queued since <time>, and says to wait instead of pushing. Otherwise inspect the Actions run page, fix why the workflow did not start, and push a new commit. GitHub cannot rerun startup_failure runs.
